audit.whatIsWrong: The entry quotes '63%' in four places (tldr, report[0], report[14], breakdown.spikes). The packet says 61.11% over 126 games.
audit.why: FAVOURED at 4/10 is the right call; only the number was inflated.
audit.corrected: All four restated at 61.11%; rating left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3], spikes[0] and content.mid all place Highlander at level 5 ('once you hit level 5 with a point in Highlander'). Highlander is the ultimate — level 6.
audit.why: This is the third matchup on this champion where the content layer hands Yi his ult a level early; a player who commits at 5 expecting slow immunity dies in the Flamespitter cone.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 now rest on Wuju Style true damage and Meditate; Highlander stated as arriving at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] calls the shield 'his Junkyard Titan shield'. Junkyard Titan is the heat passive; the shield is Scrap Shield (W), up every 6s. The content layer also never states that Electro Harpoon reduces your MAGIC RESIST, or that at 100% heat he Overheats and cannot cast at all.
audit.why: The Overheat lock is the single cleanest window in the lane and it was only half-mentioned. The MR shred matters because it is why his burn ramps on you, and the 6s shield cooldown is why the trade window is so narrow.
audit.corrected: Scrap Shield named with its 6s cooldown, Harpoon's MR reduction stated, and the Overheat cast-lock written into mid as the window to walk him down.
sources: enemyKit P 'When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating... unable to cast spells'

edits.before: Levels 4-5 turn even as your Highlander (R) lets you burst through the flame.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 turn even as Wuju Style true damage cuts his thin resists now.

edits.before: Rumble zones you early: Flamespitter (Q) melts you if you stand in it, Electro Harpoon (E) slows and chips, and his Junkyard Titan shield lets him bully - but once you hit level 5 with a point in Highlander (R) you can burst through the flame.
edits.after: Rumble zones you early: Flamespitter (Q) burns the cone for 3 seconds, Electro Harpoon (E) slows and cuts your magic resist, and Scrap Shield (W) is back every 6s - farm the edge of the cone until Wuju Style true damage arrives at 4.

edits.before: Level 4-5 is your turning point. Once you have a point in Highlander (R) you can burst through his Flamespitter (Q) and close the gap, and even his level 6 Equalizer (R) is dodgeable with your movement speed. Track his heat - punish when he's overheated and can't cast.
edits.after: Level 4-5 is your turning point, but Highlander arrives at 6, not before - until then it is Wuju Style true damage and Meditate holding the lane. Track his heat: at 100% he Overheats and cannot cast at all, which is the cleanest window you get to walk him down.

edits.after: A 61.11% lane where Rumble's Flamespitter chips you for three weak levels, then your on-hit spike turns him into free Highlander resets the moment you survive to items.

notes: All three packet.suspectNames entries are false positives ('The Equalizer', 'Electro Harpoon' are his real R and E). _missing claims Scrap Shield (W) and The Equalizer (R) deny Alpha Strike — that comes from misfired knockup/terrain flags; Riot's text describes a shield plus move speed, and a wall of flames that damages and slows, neither of which is displacement or real terrain. I wrote no such claim, matching the Rumble-side audit's conclusion. Level chart already agrees with the packet in both layers.
